description: Use when browsing events. Shows leading outcome, price, volume and event link. Use get_event for market rows. Search also matches market questions. Check `quote_tier` in get_event or get_market before quoting.

active.description: True for open, false for closed.

country_match.description: Match any (OR) or all (AND) selected countries.

created_after.description: First seen by pdata ≥ this ISO 8601 time.

created_before.description: First seen by pdata ≤ this ISO 8601 time.

hide_ended.description: Exclude past end dates, keeping undated rows.

include_uncountried.description: Also include rows without country tags.

limit.description: Alias for page_size. Both values must agree.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Must match limit if both are supplied.

search.description: English stems, case/accent insensitive. Use or, "phrases", -exclude. Typos may match. 1–2 letter terms match whole words. Alone they match titles/questions only.

sort.description: closed_time, created_at, end_date, liquidity, normalized_vol_24hr, normalized_volume, updated_at, volume, volume_24h_change, volume_24hr. Prefix - for descending. Default -normalized_vol_24hr.

source.description: Venue IDs as CSV. See get_status for public IDs.

view.description: Lean updated_at appears only without changed_at.

name: list_events
title: List prediction-market events
